name: Workload profile: Cache Intensive
description: Precomputed compound score for Cache Intensive workloads. A weighted average of normalised scores, each normalised to [0, 1] across all servers in the dataset. Component weights: 25% Redis RPS (pipeline=1, SET), 10% Redis RPS (pipeline=16, SET), 10% Redis latency (pipeline=1, SET), 10% PassMark memory latency (512 MB), 10% PassMark Memory Mark (composite), 10% PassMark cached memory reads, 10% Memory bandwidth (read, 16 MB ~ L3), 10% PassMark single-thread CPU, 5% PassMark in-memory DB operations. Rationale for component selection: In-memory key-value store workload, mixing direct Redis performance metrics with memory speed and latency benchmarks, and single-core CPU performance profiles.
